verdict.rationale: Tilled explicitly provides a dedicated sandbox environment with its own Dashboard for integration testing, separate from production, along with documented test card numbers and decline simulation to test flows without touching real data. This is corroborated by the live API being reachable and documented header contracts, showing the sandbox/testing path is real and functional. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of actual sandbox isolation from production data and no explicit mention of automated/agentic test workflows against the sandbox.
